import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { inspectParityInventory } from "../../tooling/check-v0-parity.mjs";

const baseline = JSON.parse(
  await fs.readFile(
    new URL("./v0-parity-baseline.json", import.meta.url),
    "utf8",
  ),
);

test("all 31 pinned implemented V0 tools have exactly one explicit disposition", () => {
  assert.equal(
    baseline.baseline.commit,
    "eb146dc085277386f45c4e017fcfa60cb225001d",
  );
  assert.equal(baseline.baseline.tools.length, 31);
  const result = inspectParityInventory(baseline);
  assert.equal(result.inventoryValid, true, result.errors.join("\n"));
  assert.equal(result.accountedToolCount, 31);
  assert.equal(result.groupCount, 15);
});

test("a forgotten tool is a failure, not an implicit dropped capability", () => {
  const modified = structuredClone(baseline);
  modified.groups.find((group) => group.key === "guidance").v0Tools.pop();
  const result = inspectParityInventory(modified);
  assert.equal(result.inventoryValid, false);
  assert.ok(result.errors.includes("missing disposition: guidance_fetch"));
});

test("duplicates do not inflate coverage", () => {
  const modified = structuredClone(baseline);
  modified.groups[0].v0Tools.push("read");
  const result = inspectParityInventory(modified);
  assert.equal(result.inventoryValid, false);
  assert.ok(result.errors.includes("duplicate disposition: read"));
});

test("invented baseline tools and evidence-free rows are rejected", () => {
  const modified = structuredClone(baseline);
  modified.groups[0].v0Tools.push("imaginary_v0_operation");
  modified.groups[0].evidence = [];
  const result = inspectParityInventory(modified);
  assert.equal(result.inventoryValid, false);
  assert.ok(result.errors.some((value) => value.includes("invented baseline")));
  assert.ok(result.errors.some((value) => value.includes("missing evidence")));
});

test("inventory PASS never means source, package or live acceptance", () => {
  const result = inspectParityInventory(baseline);
  assert.equal(result.inventoryValid, true);
  assert.equal(result.sourceParityComplete, false);
  assert.equal(result.liveParityQualified, false);
  assert.equal(result.qualification, "NOT_EVALUATED_BY_INVENTORY");
  const modified = structuredClone(baseline);
  modified.groups[0].livePass = true;
  assert.equal(inspectParityInventory(modified).inventoryValid, false);
});

test("additional non-MCP workflows cannot disappear from the inventory", () => {
  const modified = structuredClone(baseline);
  delete modified.additionalWorkflows;
  assert.equal(inspectParityInventory(modified).inventoryValid, false);
  for (const required of [
    "consult",
    "agent-and-model",
    "review-workflow",
    "install-update-recovery",
    "attachments-context",
    "paused-mind-drive",
  ]) {
    assert.ok(
      baseline.additionalWorkflows.some(
        (workflow) => workflow.key === required,
      ),
    );
  }
});
